title: Train
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sky-free background: none -->
  <!-- rails -->
  <rect x='2' y='86' width='96' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8a7a5c'/>
  <rect x='2' y='82' width='96' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#b8a87c'/>
  <!-- wheels -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='6' fill='#3b4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#9fb4d8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='6' fill='#3b4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#9fb4d8'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='6' fill='#3b4a6b'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='80' r='2.5' fill='#9fb4d8'/>
  <!-- cab body -->
  <rect x='58' y='46' width='32' height='34' rx='4' fill='#d63a3a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='46' width='32' height='34' rx='4' fill='none' stroke='#f07a7a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- cab window -->
  <rect x='64' y='52' width='20' height='14' rx='2' fill='#a8e0ff'/>
  <rect x='64' y='52' width='20' height='14' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- boiler -->
  <rect x='16' y='54' width='46' height='26' rx='6' fill='#e05a2b'/>
  <rect x='16' y='54' width='46' height='26' rx='6' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a6a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- boiler bands -->
  <rect x='28' y='54' width='4' height='26' fill='#ffcf3a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='54' width='4' height='26' fill='#ffcf3a'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='18' y='40' width='10' height='16' rx='2' fill='#c94a20'/>
  <rect x='16' y='36' width='14' height='6' rx='2' fill='#ffcf3a'/>
  <!-- steam puff -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='28' r='5' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='6' fill='#f2f9ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='18' r='5' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
  <!-- cowcatcher -->
  <polygon points='16,80 16,70 8,80' fill='#ffcf3a'/>
  <!-- headlamp -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='60' r='3' fill='#fff6a8'/>
  <!-- cab roof -->
  <rect x='56' y='42' width='36' height='6' rx='3' fill='#a82a2a'/>
</svg>
